verdict.rationale: Open WebUI runs tools, Python code, Open Terminal and coding agents, so an approval-gating axis fairly applies. The evidence pack documents no command allowlists, no per-action approval prompts, and no opt-in elevated modes. RBAC roles and Tether's optional workspace sandbox are adjacent controls, not approval gating, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action
